'''October 1999 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, Texas on 16 October 1999. It is known from Jeremy Losee's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d91">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-30-austin-texas-10-16-99d91/ austin-texas-10-16-99], DeckTech (Jeremy "Degenx" Losee, 30 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-30-austin-texas-10-16-99d91/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 20
